in_text_mentions: A comprehensive anatomy scan at 20 weeks' and 1-day gestation revealed fetal ascites and a small pleural effusion (Figures 2, 3, and 4). No pericardial effusion was observed. The middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity (MCA PSV) was elevated (1.95 multiples of the median (MoM)), which was suggestive of fetal anemia. At this time, routine serologic testing for herpes simplex virus (HSV), parvovirus, toxoplasmosis, and cytomegalovirus was performed.
